[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Tarkus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3642 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> he was present on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], making an arrangement with [[Kandhar]] of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang to retrieve a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] the leader of the gang supposedly possessed. Their meeting was interrupted by a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who planned to kill Kandhar to gain the trust of [[Shai Tenna]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] chose to expose Kandhar's ties to Imperials to [[Kandhar's White Maw faction|his men]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] Tarkus, angry at being betrayed.<ref name="TOR" />
